name: A Summer in Our Hearts
source:
A Summer in Our Hearts is a slice of life visual novel set to explore the life of three young adults, each from a very different background with very different personalities, and how they deal with their personal struggles. Each is trying to put their best foot forward and find their own way towards happiness. Help each other along the way, or stand by and watch as they go on their separate path. Create bonds that last for a lifetime, or walk away to build your own life. Will a short summer, away in a foreign town in the middle of nowhere, enough to push your way towards happiness?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2237520/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《我们心中的夏天》是一部生活片段视觉小说，旨在探索三个年轻人的生活，每个人都有不同的背景和不同的性格，以及他们如何处理个人的挣扎。每个人都在努力尽自己最大的努力，寻找自己的幸福之路。一路上互相帮助，或者站在一边看着他们走上各自的道路。建立持续一生的纽带，或者离开去建立自己的生活。一个短暂的夏天，在一个偏僻的外国小镇，足以推动你走向幸福吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2237520/]Steam[/url]]
